context: A uni student and friend chat
purpose: Teach: お誘い/腕時計/立ち寄っ/ふく/うわさ/閉じる/スリム/じゅう

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 蓮さん、研究会のお誘い、嬉しかったです、参加させてもらえて。
lines.en: Ren — I was really happy you invited me to the research group. Thank you for letting me join.
lines.style: Warm and sincere, a little formal. Opening softly, with genuine gratitude underneath. Pace steady and unhurried, like she's taking care with each word because it matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん。父にもらった腕時計、卒業祝いに、もらったんだ、メイちゃん。
lines.en: Yeah. My dad gave me a watch as a graduation gift.
lines.style: Quieter, almost to himself. Soft touch of memory on the object. Not wistful — just acknowledging something real and present. Brief.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 帰り道、本屋に立ち寄ったんですよ、論文資料を、探しに。
lines.en: On the way home, I stopped by a bookstore to look for research materials.
lines.style: Clear and direct, but with care underneath. Not rushing through — each phrase has weight because she's thinking about something. Honest in the telling.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 雨で、メガネ、すぐ濡れちゃう、ふく時、急がないとな。
lines.en: With the rain, my glasses keep getting wet. I have to be quick when I wipe them or I can't see.
lines.style: Light, slightly self-deprecating. A small laugh lives in the observation. Not complaining — just noticing the small frustration with the dry humor of someone used to it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 蓮さんの研究、学界で、うわさになってるって、聞きましたよ。
lines.en: I heard your research is starting to get talked about in academic circles.
lines.style: Animated and interested, eyes brightening. Forward lean in the voice. Not flattering — genuinely impressed and wanting him to know she's paying attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 論文、章を閉じる前に、もう一度、見直すよ、メイちゃん。
lines.en: I'm going to read through the paper once more before I close this chapter.
lines.style: Steady conviction underneath. Not a boast — a quiet commitment, said partly to himself. The kind of careful thoroughness that means something to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 蓮さん、研究で忙しいのに、スリムを保っていますよね、感心です。
lines.en: You manage to stay so composed even though your research keeps you so busy. I find that admirable.
lines.style: Soft and observant. Not quite shy, but holding the compliment carefully in her voice. Like she's noticed something about him and wants him to know, without pushing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今日は、一日じゅう、論文書きで終わるかもな、メイちゃん。
lines.en: Today might end up being nothing but writing that paper from start to finish.
lines.style: Light, accepting tiredness. A small wry smile in the tone. Not complaint — just stating the shape of the day ahead with a kind of resigned humor.
